newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks make modest gains at open.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks make modest gains at open.

text.p: The Australian share market edged higher at the opening on Friday with most of the leaders showing modest gains after the Dow resumed its uptrend.
The All Ordinaries index was up 6.8 points at 2,443.1.
While the market went ahead early, brokers were less than confident about the chances of early gains being sustained after initial interest petered out.

"It opened a little firmer but I don't think it will hold most of it," said a Sydney-based dealer, adding that while recent performances had been pleasing, motivating influences for the session were thin on the ground.
"There is not enough of a case to see it go ahead convincingly today but we've had a reasonable week and a strong January," the broker said.
The outlook remained for a close finish in moderate trade.
Shares in Burns Philp continued to sag, losing four cents to A$2.14 (US$1.67) after speculation that broker profit forecasts for the food ingredients group had been downgraded.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about 10 to four, while about 45 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
